Bill.BriefDescription: Using auto parts sales taxes for transportation funding.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to providing funding for transportation purposes;adding a new section to chapter 82.32 RCW; adding a new section tochapter 39.42 RCW; providing an effective date; and declaring anemergency.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 82.32 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) The treasurer shall deposit one hundred percent of stateautomobile partsrelated sales and use tax revenue in the multimodaltransportation account created in RCW 47.66.070. (2) For the purposes of this section, "automobile partsrelatedsales and use tax revenue" means revenue from the taxes imposed in RCW82.08.020(1) and 82.12.020 reported on returns filed by persons engagedin the following businesses: Automotive parts, accessories, and tirestores; motor vehicle supplies and new part wholesalers; tire and tubewholesalers; and motor vehicle used part wholesalers.

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 39.42 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: Deposits in the multimodal transportation account under section 1of this act may not be deducted from the calculation of general staterevenues under RCW 39.42.060.
This act is necessary for the immediatepreservation of the public peace, health, or safety, or support of thestate government and its existing public institutions, and takes effectJuly 1, 2003.
